reference: User-supplied small chibi pixel reference; original artist illustrations were not used

prompts.miku: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one new transparent low-resolution chibi game sprite. Use the attached reference ONLY for the pixel-art detail density, cute proportions, flat colors, compact eyes and thin white outline. Match the reference's fairly fine but clearly visible pixel grid: approximately 96 pixels tall and 80 pixels wide at native size, cleanly enlarged, around 10 output pixels per logical pixel. Not giant 32px or 48px blocks. A face with small 4-pixel-wide anime eyes, defined eyelids and just one tiny highlight, simple mouth. Head/body proportions like the reference, about 2.5 heads tall. 24-color palette, hair in 3 crisp tones with a few small block-shaped highlight clusters; flat clean pixel clusters, one-pixel dark outline plus one-pixel white outer contour. No smooth gradient, airbrush, paper texture, glossy 3D shading or detailed normal-size anime drawing. Character in an original gentle front-facing idle standing pose, arms relaxed, a small headset and full body visible. Center with transparent padding, not cropped. Actual transparent alpha background. No blue sky, ground, scenery, text, watermark, extra characters or surrounding UI. Subject: Hatsune Miku, turquoise long twin tails and dark hair clips, light gray sleeveless shirt and teal necktie, black small pleated skirt edged teal, black detached arm sleeves and boots. Pale skin, aqua eyes and cheerful little smile. Keep the same recognizability and level of simplification as the reference without copying its leek or pose. Sprite for a music player.
